supported_facts: The official Questura source reports 'several hundred' extortion episodes against business and commercial activities.
The same official excerpt refers to a violent mafia war in Lamezia Terme between 2005 and 2011.
The reviewed excerpt does not enumerate the extortion episodes individually.
The grammar of the available official excerpt does not safely establish that the 2005-2011 interval applies to every reported extortion episode.

event_identity_analysis.rationale: Approximate aggregate cardinality and non-enumerated members cannot generate individual canonical EVENT IDs.

temporal_analysis.scope_rule: The 2005-2011 interval is preserved as an assertion attached to the mafia-war context, not automatically copied to the extortion cluster.
temporal_analysis.caution: A shared sentence or investigation period is not enough to manufacture a cluster-wide occurrence interval.

geography_analysis.extortion_member_geography: not individually resolved from the reviewed excerpt

offence_analysis.caution: Do not duplicate one cluster-level classification assertion across synthetic member events.

recommended_resolution: Create an EVENT_CLUSTER with approximate cardinality text preserved verbatim/semantically. Store time/geography/count facts as separately scoped source assertions; do not assign the 2005-2011 context interval to all extortion members without additional evidence.
publication_blockers: Individual extortion occurrences are not enumerated in the reviewed official excerpt.
Extortion-specific temporal and geographic scope is not sufficiently resolved for member EVENT creation or mapping.
standard_implication: Confirms CLUSTER-SCOPE-001 independently of Shatter: cluster cardinality, contextual time, member time, contextual geography and member geography require assertion-level scope rather than one cluster-wide occurrence date/point.
